text.tspan: Remote (single repo URL or list of mirrors)
Linking the Distribution to another Publication
to update Pulp clients to a new Repository Version
(or roll back to an older one)
: (meta-)data is always whatever was available on last refresh.
• Have a global scope and are not tied to a specific repo: all ACS will be taken into account when requesting content from any repository (version)
• Have priority: when content is not available from any ACS, then Pulp will try to fetch it from the the repository (remotes).
Remote (single repo URL or list of mirrors)
